producers: molecule-ai-workspace-runtime: molecule_runtime/plugin_install_report.py (report_install_outcome, called from main.py right after install_declared_plugins)
consumers: molecule-core: workspace-server/internal/handlers/plugin_install_report.go (PluginInstallReportHandler) — POST /workspaces/{workspace_id}/plugin-install-report persists the latest report per workspace (Report); GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/plugin-install-report reads it back with live+degraded derived (Get). Both are registered on the wsAuth group at workspace-server/internal/router/router.go:581-582. The report is NOT embedded in the workspace read — there is no plugin_install_report field on GET /workspaces/{id}, and no handler issues the fleet query the migration's partial index serves; a consumer that needs either must add it.
